Next stop: the seaside 🚂

In KidPad's Trains & Buses, little travellers pick a trip, print a pretend ticket and set off.

Try taking it off the screen too. Line up some chairs, hand over the ticket and let them be the conductor. Then swap.

KidPad is £2.99 once, with no subscription and no ads. Link in bio.
